blocks.text: International and domestic flights, including the Mexico City–Mérida flight.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The 2027 Word excludes the domestic flight but has no matching combined exclusion of international and domestic airfares; preserve the RU flight scope.

blocks.text: Services and meals not expressly included in the programme.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word 2027 lists exclusions separately by day and lacks a single comprehensive programme-level services-and-meals exclusion.

blocks.text: Meals other than the lunch included on the Chichén Itzá excursion.

provenance.rationale: The approved 2027 Word explicitly includes lunch at Chichen Itza; exclude only other meals, not the included lunch.

blocks.text: Drop-off in the Tulum hotel zone or Bahía Petempich is not included.

provenance.rationale: The approved Word includes Riviera Maya transfers, but excludes Tulum hotel zone and Bahia Petempich drop-off; do not carry over the obsolete RU USD 30 charge.

blocks.text: Personal expenses, including phone calls, laundry and drinks.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word lists personal expenses but does not specify phone calls, laundry or drinks in a comparable exclusion.

blocks.text: Tips for housekeeping staff, drivers and guides.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The 2027 Word lists tips generically and does not specify the exact housekeeping, driver and guide recipients.

blocks.text: Optional English-speaking assistance, if requested as an additional service.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word has no separate optional-language assistance exclusion; translate the RU item using the agreed English-speaking guide localization.

blocks.text: If necessary, Ada Tours may replace the listed hotels with hotels of the same category.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The 2027 Word contains no general hotel-substitution clause, so translate the current RU contract note.
